title: Osteomyelitis, Acute Hematogenous (AHO) and/or Septic Arthritis
mission: Walk acute hematogenous osteomyelitis and septic arthritis in previously healthy children at least 6 months old.
checkpoints: Confirm age at least 6 months and that the child was previously healthy.
Stop under 6 months, for a toxic appearance, for contiguous or chronic osteomyelitis, for penetrating trauma, for immunocompromise, and for known rheumatologic disease.
Keep osteomyelitis and septic arthritis on the branches the algorithm separates.

cardSummary: TCH bone and joint infection standard may apply. Previously healthy children 6 months and older.

population.inclusion: Age ≥6 months; Healthy children without underlying conditions (e.g., spina bifida, sickle cell disease, immunodeficiency)
